# Before submitting a PR for review, make sure of the following steps:
- [ ] The PR has a corresponding Jira ticket
- [ ] The branch is prefixed with the Jira ticket number (`821-foo`)
- [ ] The PR title contains the full Jira ticket ID (`IT-821`)
- [ ] If this PR is part of a PR stack, the correct target branch has been selected
- [ ] In case of new features or bug fixes, at least one test was implemented
- [ ] The PR has a description that helps the reviewers do their job

Any step can be skipped in exceptional circumstances and with the proper justification.
